reason: The context-switching pain is real — I run three AI agents every day and losing context between them kills my flow — but this is the first time I've heard of Loom, on a launch day, from a vendor I've never heard of. $30/seat isn't the blocker; handing my team's shared session context, skills, hooks, and credentials to one local daemon from an unknown vendor with no audit or track record is.
objection: I don't trust an unknown vendor with my team's code, session data, and credentials on first sight — no security audit, no reputation, and if the local daemon breaks, every agent I run goes down with it.
would_change_my_mind: A third-party security audit, public source or a self-host option, or an engineering lead I already trust vouching for it.
